post_text:
This post is signed. Here's how you can check that I wrote it.
LinkedProof adds a sign button to LinkedIn's post composer. MetaMask signs a hash of the text, and the proof goes to a public Gist.
Change one character and verification fails.
#Cryptography #ContentAuthenticity
normalization: v1: NFC; CRLF->LF; NBSP->space; zero-width chars removed; "hashtag#"->"#"; runs of spaces/tabs collapsed; lines trimmed; blank lines and the "Signed by CRIPTOGRAFIA" line removed
note: EXAMPLE: signed by a throwaway key, not a real author
